intent_en: Analyze how the corporate-and-property tax burden varies across income groups, from the poorest tenth through the richest tenth and the wealthiest individuals, and determine how the groups compare.
narration_support: Usually rich people own more things, so these corporate and property taxes hit them the hardest.
narrative_goal: Show that corporate and property taxes are concentrated much more heavily on the richest income groups.
